lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin karamaa kichhoo na paaeeai je bahut lochaahee ||
lines.translation: Without good karma, he does not obtain anything, no matter how much he may wish for it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਛੁਟਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavai jaai ja(n)mai marai gur sabad chhutaahee ||
lines.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation, and birth and death are ended, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: aap karai kis aakheeai doojaa ko naahee ||16||
lines.translation: He Himself acts, so unto whom should we complain? There is no other at all. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jag mahi sa(n)tee dhan khatiaa jinaa satigur miliaa prabh aai ||
lines.translation: In this world, the Saints earn the wealth; they come to meet God through the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sach driRaaiaa is dhan kee keemat kahee na jaai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru implants the Truth within; the value of this wealth cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਧਨਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਭੁਖ ਲਥੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: it dhan paaiai bhukh lathee sukh vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: Obtaining this wealth, hunger is relieved, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿੰਨੑਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ji(n)nhaa kau dhur likhiaa tinee paaiaa aai ||
lines.translation: Only those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to receive this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh jagat niradhan hai maaiaa no bilalaai ||
lines.translation: The world of the self-willed manmukh is poor, crying out for Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin phiradaa sadaa rahai bhukh na kade jaai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, it wanders continually, and its hunger is never relieved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਆਵਈ ਨਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t na kade aavaee nah sukh vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: It never finds calm tranquility, and peace never comes to dwell in its mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿਤਵਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa chi(n)t chitavadaa rahai sahasaa kade na jaai ||
lines.translation: It is always plagued by anxiety, and its cynicism never departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਭਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin satigur mat bhavee satigur no milai taa sabad kamaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the intellect is perverted; if one meets the True Guru, then one practices the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa sukh mahi rahai sache maahi samaai ||1||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, he dwells in peace, and merges in the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin upaaee medanee soee saar karei ||
lines.translation: The One who created the world, takes care of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko simarahu bhaairahu tis bin avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; there is none other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaanaa sabad cha(n)giaaeeaa jit khaadhai sadaa tripat hoi ||
lines.translation: So eat the food of the Shabad and goodness; eating it, you shall remain satisfied forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਨਣੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: painan siphat sanaai hai sadaa sadaa ohu oojalaa mailaa kade na hoi ||
lines.translation: Dress yourself in the Praise of the Lord. Forever and ever, it is radiant and bright; it is never polluted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਥੋੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje sach dhan khatiaa thoRaa kade na hoi ||
lines.translation: I have intuitively earned the true wealth, which never decreases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੀ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehee no sabad seegaar hai jit sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: The body is adorned with the Shabad, and is at peace forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh bujheeai jis no aap vikhaale soi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Lord, who reveals Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar jap tap sa(n)jamo gurasabadee jaapai ||
lines.translation: Deep within the self are meditation and austere self-discipline, when one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai haumai agiaan gavaapai ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, egotism and ignorance are eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar a(n)mrit bharapoor hai chaakhiaa saad jaapai ||
lines.translation: One's inner being is overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar; tasting it, the flavor is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhiaa se nirabhau bhae se har ras dhraapai ||
lines.translation: Those who taste it become fearless; they are satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: har kirapaa dhaar peeaaiaa phir kaal na viaapai ||17||
lines.translation: Those who drink it in, by the Grace of the Lord, are never again afflicted by death. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕੁ ਅਵਗਣਾ ਕੀ ਬੰਨੑੈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lok avaganaa kee ba(n)nhai ga(n)thaRee gun na vihaajhai koi ||
lines.translation: People tie up bundles of demerits; no one deals in virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun kaa gaahak naanakaa viralaa koee hoi ||
lines.translation: Rare is that person, O Nanak, who purchases virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee gun paaeeanhi jis no nadar karei ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with virtue, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਹਹਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun avagun samaan hahi j aap keete karataar ||
lines.translation: Merits and demerits are the same; they are both created by the Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam ma(n)niai sukh paaeeai gurasabadee veechaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, finds peace, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar raajaa takhat hai aape kare niaau ||
lines.translation: The King sits on the throne within the self; He Himself administers justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਦਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee dar jaaneeai a(n)dar mahal asaraau ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord's Court is known; within the self is the Sanctuary, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਖੋਟਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khare parakh khajaanai paaeean khotiaa naahee thaau ||
lines.translation: The coins are assayed, and the genuine coins are placed in His treasury, while the counterfeit ones find no place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa sadaa sach niaau ||
lines.translation: The Truest of the True is all-pervading; His justice is forever True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit kaa ras aaiaa man vasiaa naau ||18||
lines.translation: One comes to enjoy the Ambrosial essence, when the Name is enshrined in the mind. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੈ ਕਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau mai karee taa(n) too naahee too hovahi hau naahi ||
lines.translation: When one acts in egotism, then You are not there, Lord. Wherever You are, there is no ego.
